session_id.description: The session ID, generated client-side. The session is reseted after 5 minutes without a page view. : UUIDv4 - xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (RFC4122)

sequence_number.description: The index of the log within this session. Each new log will increment this value, and it will be reset on the new Session

service_worker_start_date_time.description: The service worker timestamp, generated client-side when the web service worker is created. It may change during a session, eg when the service worker is killed (MV3). The id is computed from the creation timestamp and is unique per user.

session.description: Session object. Used to group events together, within a UI context.
